events.title: 첼시 boss 글렌 호들 agreed to a four-year contract as England manager after the European Football Championships . Former 맨체스터 시티 chairman Peter Swales dies of a heart attack at 63. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 are held to a 1–1 draw at 노팅엄 포리스트, helping leaders 맨체스터 유나이티드 move closer to the title.

맨체스터 유나이티드 clinched the Premier League title with a 3–0 away win against 미들즈브러 on the season's final day, also clinching a place in the European Cup . Runners-up 뉴캐슬 유나이티드, who have gone without winning a league title since 1927 and had a 12-point lead in January, are held to a 1–1 draw at 토트넘 홋스퍼, who finish eighth and miss out on a UEFA Cup place. 리버풀 finish third and draw 2–2 at Maine Road with 맨체스터 시티, who are relegated on goal difference, while Coventry and 사우샘프턴 avoid the drop, both finishing the season with goalless draws. 리버풀 will compete in next season's Cup Winners' Cup, while fourth placed 애스턴 빌라 and fifth placed 아스널 will join 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 in the UEFA Cup. Down in Division One, 밀월 are relegated five months after being top of the table, going down on the final day with 왓퍼드, while Luton's relegation was confirmed before the final game. Champions 선덜랜드 and runners-up 더비 카운티 have already secured automatic promotion, while 크리스털 팰리스, Stoke, 레스터 시티 and Charlton will contest the playoffs.

뤼트 휠릿 accepted 첼시's offer to become their player-manager, replacing 글렌 호들. Gullit, 33, is set become the youngest manager in the Premier League and one of the first foreign managers in the English game.
맨체스터 유나이티드 wins 1–0 over 리버풀 to claim the FA Cup . United becomes the first team to win the English League and Cup Double twice.
맨체스터 유나이티드 become the first English team to repeat the "double" when a late 에리크 캉토나 goal gives them a 1–0 win over 리버풀 in the FA Cup final .
미들즈브러 agree to sign 포르투 's Brazilian midfielder Emerson for £4million.
PSV claims the KNVB Cup after defeating 스파르타 로테르담 at De Kuip , 5–2.

England beat Hungary 3–0 in a friendly witnessed by incoming Three Lions manager 글렌 호들 and his second-in-command John Gorman . A Darren Anderton goal in each half coming either side of 데이비드 플래트's 27th international goal.
이언 러시 agrees to sign for 리즈 유나이티드 on a free transfer on 1 June, after spending 15 of the last 16 years with 리버풀.
글렌 호들 agrees to play for 첼시 in a posthumous testimonial match for the former 스윈던 타운 physio Kevin Morris.
잔루카 비알리 agrees to sign for 첼시 on a free transfer from 유벤투스 , who won the European Cup two days ago. 게리 스피드 agrees to join 에버턴 from 리즈 유나이티드 for £3.5million.
Although England's 22-man squad for Euro 96 has yet to be confirmed, it is reported that 35-year-old 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 forward Peter Beardsley is no longer being considered for a place in the squad.

레스터 시티 win promotion back to the Premier League with a 2–1 win against 크리스털 팰리스 at Wembley Stadium , with Steve Claridge scoring the winner during the final minute of extra time. England's Euro 96 squad is announced, but does not include Peter Beardsley, Ugo Ehiogu , 데니스 와이즈 , Robert Lee and Jason Wilcox . 스튜어트 피어스 , who is the oldest player in the England squad at 34, signs a three-year contract with 노팅엄 포리스트.
